| f-3b7e | defect | MINOR | MEDIUM — a scan that genuinely ran to completion can be reported as scan_incomplete. expansion_decision (embeddings.rs:89-108) computes expansion_exhausted = admitted_stalled \|\| expansion == MAX_CANDIDATE_EXPANSIONS, then scan_incomplete = hit_count &lt; requested && expansion_exhausted. It never subtracts the case where the vector scan actually finished. When a pass both exhausts the candidate scan (scanned &lt; candidate_limit, i.e. the index has no more rows to give) AND sees the admitted set stop growing on that same pass, both flags are true and the short page is labelled scan_incomplete even though nothing further exists to find. That is a false claim of incompleteness on an exhaustive answer, and it now propagates: crates/daemon/src/search.rs:502-508 branches on scan_incomplete to decide whether to suppress the generic filtered-empty steer, so a content-filtered search that legitimately matched nothing can be reported as a bounded short scan rather than an honest empty. It over-reports rather than under-reports, which is the safe direction, and it is exactly the inverse of the confident-lie failure search.rs:405-410 exists to prevent. Smallest fix: scan_incomplete = hit_count &lt; requested && expansion_exhausted && !candidate_scan_exhausted. The one existing unit test (embeddings.rs:1037) covers only the ceiling case with a growing admitted set, so it cannot see this. | crates/store/src/embeddings.rs:89-108,1037; crates/daemon/src/search.rs:502-508 | [x] checked | — | — | — | [acceptance_criteria](../../plan.dd.md#acceptance-criteria) | Proven, not reasoned. A disposable unit test asserting the correct value was added, run, and reverted: expansion_decision(1, 10, 100, 160, 5, Some(5), 3) — hit_count 1, requested 10, scanned 100, candidate_limit 160 (so the scan IS exhausted), admitted 5, previous_admitted Some(5) (so admitted stalled), expansion 3 (below the ceiling). Observed 'REVIEWER_EDGE: Return { scan_incomplete: true }'; assertion against Return { scan_incomplete: false } failed left/right as expected. Source restored; git diff on crates/ = 0 lines. |
